edit.subject: ancestor_of
edit.scope: Whether an ancestor of someone's ancestor is also that person's ancestor.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is an ancestor of' transitive?

cross_lingual.prompt: 维多利亚女王是乔治五世国王的祖先，乔治五世国王是伊丽莎白二世女王的祖先。能否由此推出维多利亚女王是伊丽莎白二世女王的祖先？
La reina Victoria es antepasada del rey Jorge V, y el rey Jorge V es antepasado de la reina Isabel II. ¿Se deduce que la reina Victoria es antepasada de la reina Isabel II?

derived.prompt: Queen Victoria is an ancestor of King George V, and King George V is an ancestor of Queen Elizabeth II. Does it follow that Queen Victoria is an ancestor of Queen Elizabeth II?

bridge: Patrick J. Kennedy is an ancestor of Joseph P. Kennedy Sr., and Joseph P. Kennedy Sr. is an ancestor of Caroline Kennedy.
